items.heading: Kibbeh
details: Key ingredients: bulgur, ground lamb, onion, pine nuts
Mix bulgur with ground lamb and onion into a smooth paste.
Shape into hollow ovals and stuff with a spiced meat and pine nut filling.
Seal the shells completely.
Fry until deeply golden and crisp on the outside.

items.heading: Fattoush
details: Key ingredients: toasted flatbread, cucumber, tomato, sumac, lettuce
Toast or fry pieces of flatbread until crisp.
Chop cucumber, tomato, radish and lettuce.
Toss the vegetables with a lemony sumac dressing.
Add the crisp bread pieces just before serving.

items.heading: Fatteh
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.

Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
